# Standard causal models as processes

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> x′ = F(x, u, ε) is a determined process whose move is the input and the noise. An intervention is a move not taken, unfixed by the record and fixed by the model; noise is a move not represented, and with it forgotten the process stays determined exactly where the noise makes no difference.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For any F : X → U → E → X, the standard model inputs F is the process on configurations X with moves (input, noise): x goes by (u, e) to F x u e; it is determined (inputs_determined). trajectory F x₀ u e is the trajectory from x₀ under inputs u and noise e, and inputsRun is it as a run with moves (u n, e n). For any run of inputs F, where the run has not taken (u′, e′) at x before t and X has two different elements, the record up to t fixes no outcome of (u′, e′) at x (inputs_intervention_unfixed, an instance of Run.not_fixes_of_untaken); the model sends it to F x u′ e′ and nowhere else (inputs_model_fixes). For any process whose moves are pairs, forget forgets the second part of the move: u goes from s to s′ where (u, e) does for some e; Run.forget is the corresponding run. With the noise forgotten the standard model is determined exactly where F x u e = F x u e′ for every x, u and e, e′ (forget_inputs_determined_iff). The pasted adaptive dynamics x′ = F_θ(x), θ′ = G(θ, x) is adaptive in projection-carrying-a-law, a determined process on the joint configuration. No Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Mechanism.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Mechanism.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No premise: F is any function and X, U, E any types; forget_inputs_determined_iff is two-way.
- Fixing is relative to determinacy (P53): inputs_intervention_unfixed further needs (u′, e′) untaken at x and two different elements of X, written into the theorem.
- An intervention acts on the whole move (u′, e′); a move fixing the input with the noise unrepresented is a move of the process with the noise forgotten, and when it has a unique outcome is bounded by the global form of forget_inputs_determined_iff.
- Discrete steps; no probabilities; the form x′ = F(x, u, ε) is taken from the text Ren pasted (author not stated, not Ren's wording, not a premise).

On 12 October 2026 Ren asked how a cause–effect system compares with the theory, pasted an explanation whose author is not stated (its “changing an input through an intervention can change the resulting state” is not Ren's wording), and to the AI's five proposals answered “Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”. This is the fifth proposal, work-board item P68. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): an intervention is a move not taken, fixed by a model and not by the record; retarget replaces one structural equation at one configuration and move; noise is a move not represented; Joint's contrast between a shock as a move (Shock) and written into the step (Hidden) witnesses forgetting the noise; Coarse reads as a process with its noise forgotten. See §88 of the integration note.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

14 October 2026: the current bytes of Becoming.Mechanism, Becoming.Joint are bound to consolidated receipt 20261013T221720.428753Z (passed: 91 package modules, 4983 theorems, 7020 declaration audits, every source declaration with an empty axiom report; the 90-module core closure compiles from the prelude). Earlier receipts below checked the same statements under the former names, tabulated in plan section 10. Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 30 theorems of Becoming.Mechanism all have empty axiom reports, among them inputs_determined, inputs_intervention_unfixed, inputs_model_fixes and forget_inputs_determined_iff; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §88 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

The delta is mainly placement: inputs_intervention_unfixed is a direct instance of P53 and inputs_model_fixes holds by definition, the substantive new statement being forget_inputs_determined_iff; structural equations among several variables (graphs), the do-calculus, identification of causes from observational data, probabilities and distributions, and continuous quantities and sensitivity are not stated; that input and noise are separable in an actual unfolding is not derived; surgery on a state variable corresponds to retarget only as a reading; the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; contains no ethical predicate.

- With the noise written into the step relation rather than the move, the move does not determine the step and the lone drawer's loss is overdetermined (Hidden.shock_in_the_step); forget_inputs_determined_iff characterizes for every F when this happens. [Joint.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Joint.lean)
- The record does not fix an intervention: where the run has not taken (u′, e′) at x, any two configurations can be its outcome compatibly with the record (inputs_intervention_unfixed); only the model fixes it (inputs_model_fixes). [Mechanism.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Mechanism.lean)

<a id="依赖与关联-dependencies-and-related-results"></a>
## Dependencies and related results

- **formal-reuse**: [experiment-needs-return](experiment-needs-return.md). Reuses Run.Takes, Run.Fixes and Run.not_fixes_of_untaken: an intervention unfixed by the record is its instance for the standard model.
- **formal-reuse**: [joint-difference-making](joint-difference-making.md). Reuses Determined. In Joint's witnesses the move determines the step with the shock as a move (Shock) and does not with the shock written into the step relation (Hidden.shock_in_the_step); forget_inputs_determined_iff says for every F when the process stays determined with the noise forgotten.

**Output:** In a determined process an untaken move is not fixed by the record.

**Input:** In the standard model an intervention is not fixed by the record.

**Preserved conditions:** The move untaken by the run; two different elements of X. [Experiment.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Experiment.lean)


**Output:** Determinacy; the contrast between a shock as a move and written into the step.

**Input:** The standard model's determinacy and the criterion with the noise forgotten.

**Preserved conditions:** None. [Joint.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Joint.lean)

- Related, not a proved adapter: [projection-carrying-a-law](projection-carrying-a-law.md). P66 in the same module: the system changing its own rule (adaptive) is the form of the pasted adaptive dynamics; projections carrying a law and re-absorption.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [scientific-inquiry-foundation](scientific-inquiry-foundation.md). One part of this open target: where the standard causal model's inputs, interventions and noise sit on the spine; it does not establish the whole target, and identification of causes from observation is not stated.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [counterfactual-is-the-course](counterfactual-is-the-course.md). An instance: with the part's move as the input and the rest following a law of exchange, the course is a trajectory of inputs, and an act not taken is an intervention.
